search.query: index=scoreboard_admin ctf_id="$ctf_id$" Result=* user!=admin | sort 0 user _time | eval binary=if(Result="Correct",1,0) | streamstats current=f last(binary) as previous by user | eval boundary=if(isnull(previous) OR binary!=previous,1,0) | streamstats sum(boundary) as streak_id by user | streamstats sum(binary) as WinningStreak by user streak_id | where binary=1 | stats latest(WinningStreak) as "Winning Streak" latest(Number) as Question latest(_time) as Time by user | sort - "Winning Streak" | head 10
index=scoreboard_admin ctf_id="$ctf_id$" user!=admin | stats sum(Penalty) as Penalty count(eval(Result="Incorrect")) as IncorrectAttempts by Team | sort - Penalty | head 10
